title: “Lord, teach me to trust You in the in-between moments—when answers haven’t returned yet.”
paragraphs: “Lord, teach me to trust You in the in-between moments—when answers haven’t returned yet.”

🕊️ Witnessing Hope: The Dove Released from the Ark
📖 Genesis 8:8–12
When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment.

I am not part of the story—only watching quietly.
Hidden in the shadows of the ark, I see Noah open the window. The air is still. The flood has not fully spoken yet.
Then the dove is released.

🕊️ Pause.
Not with certainty—only with hope.

That small flutter carries a question into the unknown: Has the waiting been enough?
I feel how faith sometimes looks like this—opening my hands before I have answers.

And I wonder…
What quiet hope am I being asked to release today?
💭 Share what this moment makes you feel.
